attribution: Karol J. Piczak, ESC: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification, ACM Multimedia 2015. Individual recording creators and source licenses are preserved in LICENSE.
split_policy: Official folds 1-3 train, 4 validation split by original src_file per category, 5 final test. No source recording spans groups.
limitations: Short environmental events, not realistic meeting-room noise alone.
Repeated five-second clips in mixtures are dependent examples.
Only ESC-10 subset licensing is used; full ESC-50 is not commercial-permissive.
